purpose: Illustrative Earth layers for appearance only: a cloud alpha/greyscale layer and an ocean specular (water) mask. Not used by any calculation.

clouds.meaning: Fixed illustrative cloud pattern (greyscale, 0 = clear, 255 = opaque cloud). NOT weather or cloud cover for 2027 or any specific date.
clouds.conversion: RGB JPEG -> mean of channels -> 8-bit greyscale JPEG q88. No other change.

specular.meaning: Water mask for ocean specular reflection (bright = water). Derived from imagery by Solar System Scope; may differ from the Blue Marble coastline in detail.
specular.conversion: TIFF (deflate, RGB) -> mean of channels -> 8-bit greyscale JPEG q88. No other change.

grid: simple cylindrical, 2048x1024, centred on 0 deg longitude, row 0 north: same UV as earth-visual-2k/4k.jpg

orientationCheck.note: Correlation of the specular water mask with dark-blue ocean pixels of the NASA Blue Marble ground texture; it should peak at shift 0.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Textures: Solar System Scope (https://www.solarsystemscope.com/), CC BY 4.0, based on NASA imagery; converted to greyscale JPEG for this project.
license.sourceNotes: Per the source page: based on NASA elevation and imagery data, colours tuned and slightly saturated, gaps may be filled with fictional terrain.

groundNote: The ground colour stays NASA Blue Marble (globe/earth-visual-*.jpg). The Solar System Scope colour map is not used.
